rqti 1.4.0: CRAN release preparation

Source: cran-release.md

Prepared on 2026-11-17 for Andrey Shevandrin, the unchanged CRAN maintainer. The workflow follows R Packages: Releasing to CRAN. This is a minor release because it adds scoring options and public APIs. No package has been submitted, no builder upload or email has been sent, and no release tag, GitHub release or push has been made during preparation.

Scope and baseline

Candidate: the release-preparation commit based on local main at f32abea0a24b23b5c7e4c4715e3640046a48e8da. The package was built from a temporary copy of Git-tracked files with those edits applied. Untracked local files were not included or changed.

Baseline: CRAN rqti 1.3.1, published 2026-10-01, downloaded from https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/rqti_1.3.1.tar.gz on 2026-11-17. Its SHA-256 is 86a42e3613b712f025be2ad7c54f369d534b5116ac60edda47747ab6f162f6b1. Its R sources, NAMESPACE, NEWS and bundled QTI.JS were compared with the checkout; the release tag v1.3.1 points to fd40e5e6b7673a40f40df1857a01cf66ceffbf53. All baseline R sources, NAMESPACE, NEWS.md and qti.js matched that tag. CRAN’s built 1.3.1 archive already requires R >= 4.1.0, matching this candidate; the older R requirement in the Git tag’s unbuilt DESCRIPTION is not a new user-visible minimum-version change.

The audit covers all 23 commits reachable since that tag (21 non-merge commits), including changes brought in by merges, and the resulting source/documentation diff. Maxima work on other branches is outside this candidate.

NEWS audit

NEWS.md now groups user-visible changes into features, improvements and fixes. The 1.3.1-and-earlier section is restored verbatim from CRAN’s source archive: endpoint-derived credentials, connection-specific tokens, set_opal_credentials() and render_opal() forwarding had incorrectly been attributed to 1.3.1 in the development NEWS, although they are absent from the shipped package. The optional explicit credential_id itself did ship in 1.3.1 and is not presented as new again.

Existing metadata-function and legacy preview-feedback YAML deprecations were reviewed and left at their current warning stage; this release does not remove those interfaces.

Validation

  • Source build: passed; the archive contains tracked package files, the intended release edits and standard R-generated build metadata.
  • README rebuilt with devtools::build_readme() against the candidate source; only Pandoc’s Markdown hard-line-break formatting changed.
  • urlchecker::url_check(): all URLs correct.
  • python3 tools/build-qti22-schemas.py --check: passed.
  • Local R CMD check --as-cran --timings, including incoming remote checks, examples, tests and the PDF/HTML manuals: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 notes. The checked archive passed 1,926 test assertions with 20 skips (18 live OPAL, one browser and one pre-existing empty test). After the final NEWS wording edits, the archive was rebuilt and compared with the checked archive: only NEWS and the packaging timestamp changed.
  • Test environment: Arch Linux x86_64, R 4.6.2, Pandoc 3.11. Live LMS tests are disabled (RQTI_RUN_LIVE_TESTS=false); browser integration is skipped in CI.
  • The first incoming check requested \doi{} syntax for two new scoring references; both roxygen sources and generated help pages were corrected.
  • That first complete run had no errors or warnings, one DOI-formatting NOTE, 1,926 passing test assertions and 20 skips (18 live OPAL, one browser and one pre-existing empty test). Its PDF and HTML manual checks also passed.
  • CRAN’s existing 1.3.1 checks were all OK on 13 flavors (page updated 2026-11-17 08:52:49 CET).
  • The live CRAN PACKAGES.rds index lists no direct reverse dependencies in Depends, Imports, LinkingTo or Suggests; no CRAN reverse-dependency checks are needed for that snapshot.
  • Latest main-branch CI passed macOS release, Windows release, Linux devel, Linux release and Linux oldrel-1 at 72e10e60. It does not cover local f32abea0 or these release edits.

Handoff to Andrey

Before submission:

  1. Review the release diff, especially NEWS, and push the candidate. Local f32abea0 also needs to reach the remote (remote main was 72e10e60 when inspected). Wait for the platform matrix to pass on the final revision. Use a clean checkout of that revision for any rebuilds: this working checkout contains unrelated untracked files that were excluded from the candidate.
  2. Run devtools::check_win_devel() from that exact source revision. This uploads the package and emails the registered maintainer; it has been left for Andrey. A macOS builder check is optional if the final macOS CI result is clean.
  3. Add the final platform/builder results to cran-comments.md. Recheck CRAN status, URLs and reverse dependencies if submission is delayed or code changes.
  4. Submit the exact checked source archive at https://cran.r-project.org/submit.html with cran-comments.md. Alternatively, run devtools::submit_cran() from the clean, checked source revision. Confirm the CRAN email sent to shevandrin@gmail.com.
  5. After CRAN accepts 1.4.0, tag the submitted commit as v1.4.0, create the GitHub release from NEWS, update the website and bump development to 1.4.0.9000.

The final archive and supporting logs/snapshots are saved under output/cran-1.4.0-20261117/, which is already ignored by Git and excluded from package builds. The source archive is rqti_1.4.0.tar.gz, with SHA-256 7ca6aed35085171ae485c9f620a7819cc654e31907594214c711e5be37b9f091. The folder also contains the final check/install/test logs, CRAN/URL snapshots, a review patch (release-preparation.patch), manifest.json and SHA256SUMS. The patch records the preparation edits, including this checklist; apply it to f32abea0 if transferring the work to another checkout. Scratch builds are in /tmp/rqti-cran-release-20261117/. This checklist and cran-comments.md are also excluded from the source package.
